verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents control over how long Copilot keeps prompts, suggestions or session data, or any way to delete it. The closest item is an opt-out from AI model training for individual subscribers (github-copilot-docs-12). That governs how data is used, not how long it is kept or whether it can be deleted, so it does not deliver this story. The community concern about training on enterprise code is skepticism, not evidence about retention controls.
